observations: B2M sits beside the class-I heavy chain outside the presenting-cell membrane; the repeated 1/2/3 alleles are explicitly illustrative.
Both class-I and class-II contacts show separate TCR and CD8/CD4 contacts between two cell membranes. The class-II alpha and beta chains both cross the presenting-cell membrane.
The folded-epitope comparison distinguishes an accessible folded surface from a processed peptide-HLA surface and explicitly separates recognition from killing.
All labels are readable at the inspected native dimensions; this is not mobile, contrast, glyph-metric or accessibility acceptance.
